value.rationale: A precise sampling-design safety frontier: repulsion exponent >1 is necessary and sufficient for unconditional mean-square amplification of full polynomial interpolation; iid and projection DPP designs lie on opposite sides. The threshold is degree independent, the Gaussian-noise interpretation is operationally meaningful, and an exact two-node law is a natural calibration benchmark. No downstream universal algorithmic guarantee is asserted.
